items.name: Camellia Wilmington Printed Garment-Dyed Tee
items.alt: Ivory tee printed on the chest with a lifelike painted red camellia branch, hanging from a camellia shrub in a historic Wilmington garden, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A relaxed garment-dyed tee printed with a lifelike painted red camellia branch, bloom and glossy leaves, a Wilmington NC garden favorite. Made to order.
facts: Relaxed fit, offered in sizes L to 3XL (S and M are not offered yet)
Heavyweight 6.1 oz ring-spun cotton, pre-shrunk, double-needle stitching, no side seams
Camellia illustration printed on the front chest, not embroidered
